About

Hello! I am a Junior at Penn studying Computer Science and Mathematics. I am also pursuing an Accelerated Masters in Robotics from the GRASP Lab. My current interests are

  • Deep Learning
  • Applied Optimization
  • Controls for Robotics

Recently, I have been working on finding better optimization methods for multi-task representation learning with Anton Xue andThomas Zhang who wrote a wonderful writeup of the project here.

See more of my projects below!

Outside of work, I play soccer, DJ for events around campus and am involved with Penn Student Government. Contact me at farazr [at] seas [dot] upenn [dot] edu.

Optimizing for Representation Learning

This project explores algorithms that split model training into two parts: learning representations (i.e. Phi) and learning task heads (i.e. F^(t)). The work is motivated by the fact that classical methods don't work well in this setting.
